A superiorly based SCM muscular flap was then elevated, medially rotated and interposed between the esophagus and the cervical column to protect the viscus repair (Figure 3).

limitations: Caption spells the white marker colour as "wight"; the pixels show a white arrow and a white star on the left image and a black star on the right image.
